title: Croatian Creamy Garlic Tart
description: A rich and savory tart that combines the flavors of Croatia with a creamy garlicky filling, all in a flaky pastry crust.
instructions: Roll out the garlicky pastry dough to a thickness of about 1/8 inch.
Transfer the dough to a 9-inch tart pan with a removable bottom.
In a medium bowl, mix together the mascarpone cheese and bake until smooth.
Spread the mascarpone mixture evenly over the pastry dough, leaving a 1-inch border around the edges.
Top with toasted croatian crostini and crumbled bake.
Bake the tart for 25-30 minutes or until the crust is golden brown and the filling is set.
Remove the tart from the oven and let it cool on a wire rack for at least 10 minutes.
Serve warm, garnished with fresh herbs if desired.
